description: Core gameplay numbers, as in the original game. player: max_health (100) and max_saturation (300, the health-drink overheal cap). health_items: how much each healing item restores. grab_escape: the number of button inputs needed to break free of an enemy grab, per situation, as [easy, normal, hard]. Changing these changes the game balance. A mod changes it with a file of the same path in its own folder; objects are merged key by key, so the patch only needs the keys it changes. Keys must keep their names.

health_items.description: Health restored by each item, in health points (max_health is 100): first_aid_kit 80, health_drink 40, ampoule 100 (the ampoule also fills the saturation).

grab_escape.description: Inputs needed to break free of a grab, as [easy, normal, hard]. Keys name the player's state while grabbed (on_floor, grab_pinned_front, grab_torso_back, ...).
